sections.title: The command given to the children of Israel to depart from Sinai.

verses.text: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በምድረ በዳ፥ በምዕራብ በኩል በኤርትራ ባሕር አጠገብ በፋራንና በጦፌል፥ በላባንና በአውሎን፥ በካታኪሪሲያም መካከል፥ ሙሴ ለእስራኤል ሁሉ፥ የነገራቸው ቃላት እኒህ ናቸው።
በሴይር ተራራ መንገድ ከኮሬብ እስከ ቃዴስ በርኔ ድረስ የዐሥራ አንድ ቀን ጕዞ ነው።
በአርባኛው ዓመት በዐሥራ አንደኛው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን፥ ሙሴ እንዲነግራቸው እግዚአብሔር ስለ እነርሱ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ነገራቸው፤
በሐሴቦን ተቀምጦ የነበረውን የአሞሬዎናውያንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥ በአስጣሮትና በኤድራይን ተቀምጦ የነበረውንም የባሳንን ንጉሥ ዐግን ከገደሉት በኋላ፥
በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በሞዓብ ምድር ሙሴ እንዲህ ብሎ ይህን ሕግ ይገልጥ ጀመር፦
“አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረን፦ በዚህ ተራራ መቀመጣችሁ በቃ፤
ተመልሳችሁ ተጓዙ፤ ወደ አሞራውያን ተራራ፥ ወደ አረባም ሀገሮች ሁሉ፥ በተራራውም፥ በሜዳውም፥ በሊባም፥ በባሕርም ዳር ወዳሉ ወደ ከነዓናውያን ምድር፥ ወደ ሊባኖስም ፊት ለፊት እስከ ታላቁ ወንዝ እስከ ኤፍራጥስ ድረስ ሂዱ።
እነሆ፥ ምድሪቱን ሰጠኋችሁ፤ ግቡ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለእነርሱ፥ ከእነርሱም በኋላ ለዘራቸው ይሰጣት ዘንድ ለአባቶቻችሁ ለአብርሃምና ለይስሐቅ ለያዕቆብም የማለላቸውን ምድር ውረሱ።

sections.title: Moses appointed the leaders of the people.

verses.text: “በዚያም ዘመን እንዲህ ብዬ ተናገርኋችሁ፦ እኔ ብቻዬን ልሸከማችሁ አልችልም፤
አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር አብዝቶአችኋልና፥ እነሆም፥ እናንተ ዛሬ እንደ ሰማይ ከዋክብት ብዙዎች ናችሁ።
የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ቍጥር ላይ እልፍ አእላፋት ይጨምር፤ እንደ ተናገራችሁም ይባርካችሁ።
እኔ ብቻዬን ድካማችሁን፥ ሸክማችሁንም፥ ክርክራችሁንም እሸከም ዘንድ እንዴት እችላለሁ?
ከእናንተ ከየነገዳችሁ ጥበበኞች፥ አስተዋዮችም፥ ዐዋቂዎችም የሆኑትን ሰዎች አምጡ፤ እኔም በላያችሁ አለቆች አደርጋቸዋለሁ።
እናንተም፦ ‘እናደርገው ዘንድ የተናገርኸው ይህ ነገር መልካም ነው’ ብላችሁ መልሳችሁ ነገራችሁኝ።
ከእናንተም ጥበበኞችና ዐዋቂዎች፥ አስተዋዮችም የሆኑትን ሰዎች ወሰድሁ፤ በእናንተም ላይ አለቆች፥ የሻለቆችም፥ የመቶ አለቆችም፥ የአምሳ አለቆችም፥ የዐሥር አለቆችም፥ ለፈራጆቻችሁም ጻፎች አድርጌ ሰየምኋቸው።
በዚያን ጊዜ ፈራጆቻችሁን አዘዝኋቸው። አልኋቸውም፦ የወንድሞቻችሁን ነገር ስሙ፤ በሰውና በወንድሙ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ባለው መጻተኛ መካከል በጽድቅ ፍረዱ።
በፍርድም ፊት አትዩ፤ ለትልቁም፥ ለትንሹም በእውነት ፍረዱ፤ ለሰው ፊት አታድሉ፤ ፍርድ የእግዚአብሔር ነውና። አንድ ነገር ቢከብዳችሁ እርሱን ወደ እኔ አምጡት፤ እኔም እሰማዋለሁ፤
በዚያን ጊዜም ልታደርጉት የሚገባችሁን ነገር ሁሉ አዘዝኋችሁ።

sections.title: And the soldiers who were sent from the holy place unto Canaan.

verses.text: "And we departed from Kadesh; our God, the Lord, commanded us to go forth, and we journeyed through the wilderness, greatly fearing, and we walked along the way of the Amorites, and we came to the gate of the city."
"And I said unto you: 'Our God, the Lord, go up unto the mountain of the Amorites until He has delivered it unto you.'"
"Behold, your God, the Lord, has set the land before you, as He has given it unto you; the God of your fathers, the Lord, has said unto you: 'Do not be afraid; do not be dismayed.'"
"And you all drew near unto me, saying: 'Let us send men before us, that they may search out the land and bring us word of the way by which we must go up and the cities unto which we shall come.'"
"And this thing pleased me well; and I took twelve men of you, one man from each tribe."
"And they turned and went up into the mountain; and they came unto the valley of Eshcol and searched it out."
"And they took in their hands of the fruit of the land and brought it down unto us, saying: 'Our God, the Lord, has given us a good land.'"
"And you did not wish to go up; but you rebelled against the command of the Lord your God."
"And in your tents you murmured, saying: 'The Lord will bring us forth to destroy us by the hand of the Amorites, to deliver us unto the land of Egypt.'"

"And whither shall we go up? Our brethren have discouraged our hearts, saying: 'The people are greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the giants there.'"
And I said unto you: Fear not; neither be dismayed at them.
Your God, the Lord, who goeth before you, He shall fight for you, according to all that He did for you in Egypt before your eyes.
And until you come to this place, your God, the Lord, shall not forsake you in all the way that you go, as He has been with you in the wilderness.
Yet in this matter, your God, the Lord, you did not believe.
And He shall choose a place for you, and show you the way that you should go, by night with fire, and by day with a cloud before you; yet you did not believe.

sections.title: The Lord shall deliver Israel as a flock.

verses.text: “እግዚአብሔርም የቃላችሁን ድምፅ ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤ እንዲህም ብሎ ማለ፦
ለአባቶቻችሁ እሰጣት ዘንድ የማልሁላቸውን መልካሚቱን ምድር ከእነዚህ ሰዎች ማንም አያይም፥
ከዮፎኒ ልጅ ከካሌብ በስተቀር፥ እርሱ ግን ያያታል፤ እግዚአብሔርን ፈጽሞ ተከትሎአልና የረገጣትን ምድር ለእርሱ፥ ለልጆቹም እሰጣለሁ።
እግዚአብሔርም በእናንተ ምክንያት በእኔ ተቈጣ፤ እንዲህም አለ፦ አንተ ደግሞ ወደዚያ አትገባም፤
በፊትህ የሚቆም የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ እርሱ ወደዚያ ይገባል፤ እርሱን አበርታው፤ ለእስራኤል ምድሪቱን ያወርሳልና።
ደግሞ፦ ይማረካሉ ያላችኋቸው ልጆቻችሁ፥ ዛሬም መልካሙን ከክፉ መለየት የማይችሉ ሕፃኖቻችሁ እነርሱ ወደዚያ ይገባሉ፤ ምድሪቱንም ለእነርሱ እሰጣለሁ፤ ይወርሱአታልም።
እናንተ ግን ተመልሳችሁ በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሂዱ።
“እናንተም፦ እግዚአብሔርን በድለናል፤ አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘን ሁሉ እንወጣለን፤ እንዋጋማለን ብላችሁ መለሳችሁልኝ። ከእናንተም ሰው ሁሉ የጦር መሣሪያውን ያዘ፤ ወደ ተራራም ወጣችሁ።
እግዚአብሔርም፦ እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር አይደለሁምና በጠላቶቻችሁ ፊት እንዳትወድቁ አትውጡ፤ አትዋጉም በላቸው አለኝ።
እኔም ተናገርኋችሁ፤ እናንተ ግን አልሰማችሁም፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃል ተላለፋችሁ፤ በኀይላችሁም ወደ ተራራማው አገር ወጣችሁ።
And in that mountainous land dwelt the Amorites, and they were taken captive; they were crushed as a moth is crushed; they were destroyed; from Seir even unto Hermon, they perished.
You were also made to stand before our God, before the Lord; yet the Lord did not hear your voice, nor did He regard you.
In former times, as you had settled in that age, you have dwelt many days in the wilderness.

sections.title: Israel in the wilderness of their sojourn years.

verses.text: "And the Lord said unto me, 'Return, by the way of the Red Sea, and go unto the wilderness'; and the mountain of Seir was very great before us."
And the Lord spoke unto me, saying:
"This mountain shall be a possession for you; turn yourselves and go unto the land of the Moabites."
Thus shalt thou command the people, saying: "You shall pass through the land of your brethren, the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; they shall be afraid of you; take good heed unto yourselves."
"I have given the mountain of Seir unto the children of Esau for a possession; therefore I have not given you any of their land, even to the breadth of a foot, for I have not given it unto you."
"You shall eat their food for money, and you shall drink their water for money."

"The Lord your God hath blessed all the work of your hand; know ye how great and terrible this wilderness hath been, for these forty years the Lord your God hath been with you; you have lacked nothing."

"And when we passed by our brethren, the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath and from Ezion-geber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab."
"And the Lord said unto me: 'I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession; thou shalt not distress the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle.'"
"As the giants were great and many, the mighty men of old, they dwelt there before."
And they were known as the Rephaim, as was said of Enoch; but the Moabites called them "Omin."

The Horites also dwelt in Seir before, but the children of Esau destroyed them; they drove them out from before them, and the Lord gave them the land of the Horites as a possession, and they dwelt in their place.
Now arise and go forth; let us flee from the fear of today; let us flee from the fear of today.

And the fear of today until we fled, the Lord said concerning them, the men of that generation who became warriors, until they were driven out from among their dwellings, until they were lost, it became a time of thirty-eight years.
From among the dwellers, until they were lost, the hand of the Lord was upon them.
"Thus it was; the warriors were lost, among the people, after death."
The Lord spoke to me, saying:
"You shall pass today through the border of Moab, through Ar,

And because I have given a heritage to the children of Lot, I will not give you the land of the children of Ammon as a heritage; and when you come near to the children of Ammon, do not distress them; do not provoke them."
And that land was called the land of the Rephaim; and the Rephaim had dwelt there before; but the Ammonites called them "Zamzummim."
እነርሱም እንደ ዔናቃውያን ታላቅና ብዙ፥ ጽኑዓንም ሕዝብ ነበሩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከፊታቸው አጠፋቸው፤ እነርሱንም አሳድደው በስፍራቸው ተቀመጡ።
ሖራውያንን ከፊታቸው አጥፍቶ በሴይር ለተቀመጡት ለዔሳው ልጆች እንዳደረገ እነርሱ ወረሱአቸው፤ በእነርሱም ፋንታ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ተቀመጡ።
እስከ ጋዛም ድረስ በአሴሮት ተቀምጠው የነበሩትን ኤዋውያንንና ከቀጰዶቅያ የወጡ ቀጰዶቃውያንን አጠፉአቸው፤ በእነርሱም ፋንታ ተቀመጡ።
ደግሞም አለ፦ ተነሥታችሁ ሂዱ፤ የአርኖንንም ሸለቆ ተሻገሩ፤ እነሆ፥ አሞሬዎናዊውን የሐሴቦንን ንጉሥ ሴዎንን፥ ምድሩንም በእጅህ አሳልፌ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ እርስዋን ግዛት፤ ውረሳት፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ተዋጋ።
ከሰማይ በታች ባሉ አሕዛብ ሁሉ ላይ ማስደንገጥህንና ማስፈራትህን እሰድድ ዘንድ ዛሬ እጀምራለሁ፤ ስምህን በሰሙ ጊዜ በፊትህ ይንቀጠቀጣሉ፤ ድንጋጤም ይይዛቸዋል።

sections.title: And Israel smote King Sihon, as he had done. (Numbers 21:21-30)

verses.text: "And to the king of Heshbon, to Sihon, I sent messengers to say:
'I will pass through your land; I will go along the highway; I will turn neither to the right nor to the left.
Sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink; only let me pass through on foot.
As the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Aror, did unto me, so shall our God, the Lord, give us the land until I cross over Jordan on foot.
But Sihon, king of Heshbon, would not let us pass; for the Lord your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is this day.
And the Lord said unto me, 'Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before you; begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.'
And Sihon and all his people came out against us unto Jahaz.
And our God, the Lord, delivered him into our hands, and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
And at that time we took all the cities, and utterly destroyed the cities, and the women, and the children; we left not a single one alive.
Except for the livestock, and the spoil of the cities which we took, we devoted them to ourselves."

From the region of the Arnon, which is adjacent to the city of Aroer, and from within the valley, we began from the city unto the mountain of Gilead; yet no city was mentioned unto us. Our God, the Lord, delivered all into our hands.

But our God, the Lord, commanded us to go unto the land of the children of Ammon, and to the region of Jabbok, and unto all the place that is called Aeloth, and we did not come unto the cities that are in the mountainous land.

sections.title: And the children of Israel smote Og, the king of Bashan, as they had smitten him.

verses.text: "We returned and went forth by the way of Bashan; and Og, the king of Bashan, came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei."

"And the Lord said unto me: 'Fear him not, for I have delivered him and all his people and his land into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon, king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.'"
"Our God, the Lord, also delivered into our hands Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people; and we utterly destroyed them, so that there was not a remnant left to him."

"At that time we took all the cities of those kings, and there was not a city which we took not from them; we took the kingdom of Og, which was in Bashan, all the region of Argob, and all the threescore cities."
"And there were many cities very great and fortified, with high walls, gates, and bars, besides a great many unwalled towns."
"And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon, king of Heshbon; we utterly destroyed every city, and all the women and children, we left not a remnant."
"And we took all the cattle of those cities, and the spoil of the cities we took for ourselves."
"And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Hermon, which is called Sirion, we took it from the hand of the two kings of the Amorites."
"The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion; and the Amorites call it Senir."
"And all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, which was called the land of giants, we took; even unto Elkeid and unto Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og."

And there remained only Og, the king of Bashan, who was of the remnant of the giants; behold, his bed was a bed of iron. Is it not in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was the length of his bed and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.

sections.title: The dwellers on the east side of the Jordan.

verses.text: "This land also I gave as a possession, from the Arnon ravine, which is on the edge of the land of the Amorites, even from Aroer, which is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Gilead, and all Bashan, which is called the land of giants."
"And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, which was called the land of giants, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants."
"And the son of Manasseh, Jair, took all the region of Argob unto the coast of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashan-havoth-jair, unto this day."
"And unto Machir I gave Gilead."
"And unto the Reubenites and the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon, half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon."

"And the rest of the plain, and all the region of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and half Gilead, and all Bashan, which was called the land of giants, I gave unto the children of Machir, the son of Manasseh."
"At that time I commanded you, saying, The Lord your God hath given you this land to possess it; ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are fit for the war."
"But I know that you have many cattle, and your wives and your little ones shall remain in the cities which I have given you."

"And the Lord your God, as He hath done unto you, and until He hath driven out your brethren, as He hath done unto you, so shall you inherit the land which the Lord your God giveth you, and you shall return every man unto his possession which I have given you."
"And at that time I commanded Joshua, saying, Your eyes have seen all that the Lord your God hath done unto these two kings; so shall the Lord do unto all the kingdoms whither thou goest."
Your God, the Lord, He shall fight for you; therefore, do not be afraid of them.

sections.title: And Moses was admonished that he should not enter the land of promise.

verses.text: “በዚያም ዘመን እኔ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ ብዬ ለመንሁት፦
ጌታ እግዚአብሔር ሆይ! ታላቅነትህንና ኀይልህን፥ የጸናች እጅህንና የተዘረጋች ክንድህን ለእኔ ለአገልጋይህ ማሳየት ጀምረሃል፤ በሰማይና በምድርም እንደ ሥራህ፥ እንደ ኀይልህም ይሠራ ዘንድ የሚችል አምላክ ማን ነው?
እኔ እንድሻገርና፥ በዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ያለችውን መልካሚቱን ምድር፥ ያንም መልካሙን ተራራማውን ሀገር አንጢ ሊባኖስንም እንዳይ ፍቀድልኝ።
እግዚአብሔር ግን በእናንተ ምክንያት ተቈጣኝ፤ አልሰማኝምም፤ እግዚአብሔርም አለኝ፦ ‘ይበቃሃል፤ በዚህ ነገር ደግመህ አትናገረኝ።’
ይህን ዮርዳኖስን አትሻገርምና ወደ ተራራው ራስ ውጣ፤ ዐይንህንም ወደ ባሕር ወደ መስዕም፥ ወደ አዜብም ወደ ምሥራቅም አንሥተህ በዐይንህ ተመልከት።
ኢያሱ በዚህ ሕዝብ ፊት ይሻገራልና፥ አንተም የምታያትን ምድር እርሱ ያወርሳቸዋልና ኢያሱን እዘዘው፤ አደፋፍረውም፥ አጽናውም።
በቤተ ፌጎርም ፊት ለፊት በሸለቆው ውስጥ ተቀመጥን።

sections.title: A counsel given that the people of Israel should be as new wine.

verses.text: "Now therefore, O Israel, that you may observe to do, that you may live and multiply, and go in to possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you, today hear the statutes and judgments which I teach you."
"Today I command you to keep the commandments of the LORD your God; you shall not add to the word which I command you, nor take from it."
"Every person who follows Baal-Peor, your God the LORD has separated from you and your God the LORD has not opened your eyes to see what He has done to Baal-Peor."
"But you, who have followed the LORD your God, are alive, every one of you, to this day."
"Behold, you are to enter the land which you are to possess; thus the LORD your God has commanded me to show you the statutes and judgments."
"Keep them; do them; hear all these statutes: behold, 'This great nation is a wise and understanding people,' for your wisdom and understanding in the sight of the nations."
"Our God the LORD, who is it that is presented to us at all times? Who is this great nation?"
"Today, before you, what great nation is there that has such righteous statutes and judgments as this whole law which I set before you?"

"Know for yourself; keep your body; do not let your eyes stray from all these things; throughout your lifetime, let them not depart from your heart; teach them to your children and your children's children."

"The LORD gathered the people to me; they shall teach me to fear Him all the days they live upon the earth, and they shall teach their children to do so, that they may hear my words, and in the time of your gathering, speak to them before your Creator, the LORD."
And you stood beneath the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto heaven; there was darkness, and a thick cloud, and a very dark mist.
And the Lord spoke unto you out of the midst of the fire; ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
And he commanded you to perform the ten words of the covenant; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
That ye may inherit the land whither ye go to possess it, and that ye may learn to do the statutes and judgments which the Lord your God shall teach you, and in that time the Lord commanded me.

sections.title: A warning given concerning the worship of idols.

verses.text: "The Lord, in the midst of the fire upon Mount Horeb, did not show you His form on the day He spoke to you; therefore, take great care for your souls;
lest you corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, the likeness of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
the likeness of any beast that is on the earth, and the likeness of any winged fowl that flies in the air,
the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, and the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth.

Do not lift up your eyes to heaven; your God, the Lord, has given the sun and the moon, and all the host of heaven to all the nations under heaven; do not be led astray to worship them, nor serve them, but take heed to yourselves.
But you shall be a people of inheritance, as today, for the Lord your God has brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the iron furnace.
And the Lord was angry with you because of your words; and He swore that you should not cross the Jordan, nor enter the good land which the Lord your God is giving you for an inheritance.
But I, I shall die in this land; I shall not cross the Jordan; but you shall cross and possess the good land.
Take care not to forget the covenant of the Lord your God, which He made with you; and make not for yourselves a graven image, the likeness of anything which the Lord your God has forbidden you.
For the Lord your God is a consuming fire, a jealous God."

"Children, and the children of your children, during the time of your birth, when you dwell long in the land, when you are in your prosperity, and at whatever time you make an image that is carved, do not forget that in the sight of your God, the Lord, it is an evil thing that you have done."

"You shall hasten to escape from the land to which you shall be driven, and I today call heaven and earth as witnesses against you; you shall surely perish, and you shall not prolong your days upon the land."
"And the Lord shall be among the nations; the Lord shall dwell in your midst, and though you be few in number among the nations, you shall be preserved."

"And you shall not regard those that cannot be seen, nor those that cannot be heard, nor those that cannot be eaten, nor those that cannot be worshipped, for they are made by the hands of man from wood and stone."
"But you shall choose the Lord your God; in your time of distress, with all your heart, and with all your soul, you shall seek Him, and you shall find Him."
"All these things shall come upon you in the latter days; and you shall return to your God, and to the Lord, and you shall hear His voice."
"Your God, the Lord, is a merciful God; He will not forsake you, nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which He swore to them."
"The Lord created man upon the earth, and from the heavens to the heavens, there is nothing great like this, nor has there ever been anything like it before you."
"You shall hear the voice of the living God as He speaks among the flames, and you shall be as one who lives, and another people shall hear as if it were so."

"Our God, the Lord, before your eyes in Egypt, as He did all the wonders, through trials and signs, through great and mighty deeds, with a stretched-out hand and an outstretched arm, the Lord shall take for Himself a people from among the nations."
እግዚአብሔርም አምላክ እንደ ሆነና ከእርሱም ሌላ አምላክ እንደ ሌለ እንድታውቅ፥
ያስተምርህ ዘንድ ከሰማይ ድምፁን አሰማህ፤ በምድርም ላይ ታላቁን እሳት አሳየህ፤ ከእሳቱም መካከል ቃሉን ሰማህ።
አባቶችህን ወድዶአልና ከእነርሱ በኋላ ዘራቸውን መረጠ፤ ከአንተም ጋር ሆኖ በታላቅ ኀይሉ ከግብፅ አወጣህ፤
ዛሬ እንደ ሆነው ሁሉ ከግብፅ ከአንተ የጸኑትን ታላላቆቹን አሕዛብ በፊትህ እንዲያወጣ፥ አንተንም እንዲያገባህ፥ ምድራቸውንም ርስት አድርጎ እንዲሰጥህ፥
እንግዲህ እግዚአብሔር በላይ በሰማይ በታችም በምድር አምላክ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሌላም እንደ ሌለ ዛሬ ዕወቅ፤ በልብህም ያዝ።
ለእናንተ፥ ከእናንተም በኋላ ለልጆቻችሁ መልካም ይሆን ዘንድ፥ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ለዘለዓለም በሚሰጣችሁ ምድር ዕድሜአችሁ ይረዝም ዘንድ፥ እኔ ዛሬ የማዝዛችሁን ሥርዐቱንና ትእዛዙን ጠብቁ።”

sections.title: Cities of refuge for the slayers of the soul.

verses.text: At that time, Moses designated three cities in the region east of the Jordan, in the wilderness.
Yesterday, he who had not been an enemy to his neighbor, even without knowing it, shall flee to one of these cities and live.
For Reuben, there was a territory in the wilderness, in the land of Dibon; for Gad, there was a territory in Gilead; and for Manasseh, there was a territory in Bashan.

sections.title: An explanation concerning His commandments.

verses.text: And Moses spoke unto the children of Israel, saying, This is the law;
When they came forth from Egypt, Moses declared unto the children of Israel a witness and a statute; this is the judgment.

And after the children of Israel had come forth from Egypt, Moses spoke unto them, while they were encamped in Heshbon, near the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, by the valley that is over against Beth Peor, by the Jordan River.
Take possession of the land of the kings of the Amorites, and the land of Bashan, which was on the east side of the Jordan River, the two kingdoms of the Amorites.
From the river Arnon, which is at the border, from Aroer unto the mountain of Sihon, even unto Hermon.
And on the eastern side of the Jordan River, from the mountain of Aseiron, take all the land that is beneath it, even the whole region of the Arabah.

sections.title: The Ten Commandments

verses.text: ሙሴም እስራኤልን ሁሉ ጠርቶ አላቸው፥ “እስራኤል ሆይ እንድትማሩአትም፥ በማድረግም እንድትጠብቁአት ዛሬ በጆሮአችሁ የምናገራትን ሥርዐትና ፍርድ ስሙ።
አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር በኮሬብ ከእናንተ ጋር ቃል ኪዳኑን አጸና።
እግዚአብሔር ዛሬ በዚህ በሕይወት ካላችሁት ከእናንተ ከሁላችሁ ጋር እንጂ ከአባቶቻችሁ ጋር ይህችን ቃል ኪዳን አላጸናም።
በተራራው ላይ በእሳት መካከል እግዚአብሔር ፊት ለፊት ተናገራችሁ።
እኔ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እነግራችሁ ዘንድ በዚያን ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔርና በእናንተ መካከል ቆሜ ነበር፤ እናንተ ከእሳቱ ፊት ፈርታችኋልና፥ ወደ ተራራው አልወጣችሁምና። እርሱም አለ፦
“ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ያወጣሁህ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ እኔ ነኝ።
“ከእኔ በቀር ሌሎች አማልክት አይሁኑልህ።
“በላይ በሰማይ ካለው፥ በታችም በምድር ካለው፥ ከምድርም በታች በውኃ ካለው ነገር ማንኛውንም ምሳሌ፥ የተቀረጸውንም ምስል ለአንተ አታድርግ፤
አትስገድላቸው፤ አታምልካቸውም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላክህ ቀናተኛ አምላክ ነኝና፤ በሚጠሉኝ እስከ ሦስተኛና እስከ አራተኛ ትውልድ ድረስ የአባቶችን ኀጢአት በልጆች ላይ የማመጣ፤
ለሚወድዱኝ፥ ትእዛዜንም ለሚጠብቁ እስከ ሺህ ትውልድ ድረስ ምሕረትን የማደርግ።
"Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh His name in vain."
"Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy; as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee."
"Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work;"

"But the seventh day is the Sabbath of the Lord thy God; in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy ox, nor thy ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou."

"Remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the Lord thy God brought thee out thence with a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm; therefore the Lord thy God commanded thee to keep the Sabbath day."
"Honor thy father and thy mother, as the Lord thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee in the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee."
"Thou shalt not kill."
"Thou shalt not commit adultery."
"Thou shalt not steal."
"Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor; neither shalt thou desire any false witness."
"Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's wife; thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's house, his field, his servant, his maid, his ox, his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbor's."

"The Lord spoke unto you out of the midst of the fire; ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice. And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone."

sections.title: Concerning the fear of the people.

verses.text: "Thus it came to pass; when the voice was heard among you in the midst of the fire, and the mountain trembled with the fire, you, your leaders, your elders, drew near unto me;
And I said unto you: Behold, the Lord our God hath shown us His glory and His greatness; we have heard His voice out of the midst of the fire; and when the Lord spoke with man, man liveth not today.
Now do not be afraid; for this great fire shall not consume you; if we hear again the voice of the Lord our God, we shall surely die.
Who is there among all flesh that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
Draw near; hear all that the Lord our God shall say; and all that the Lord our God shall speak unto you, let us hear it, and we will do it.

"And when I spoke unto you, the Lord heard the voice of your words; and the Lord said unto me: I have heard the voice of this people, which they have spoken unto thee; they have well said all that they have spoken.
May it be well with them, and with their children forever, that they may fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it may be well with them and their children.
Go, return unto your tents.

But you, stand here by me, and I will speak unto you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments which you shall teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess.
And the Lord your God commanded you to keep, that you should do; turn not aside to the right hand or to the left."

"That you may live and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the Lord your God is giving you, walk in all the ways which the Lord your God has commanded you."

sections.title: The Great Commandment

verses.text: "That you may be careful to do according to all that your God, the Lord, has commanded you, as He has instructed you, this is the decree and the ordinance, and this is the judgment."

"You and your children, and the children of your children, shall fear the Lord your God all the days of your life, to keep all His statutes and His commandments which I command you, that your days may be prolonged."

"Hear, O Israel: The land which the Lord your God is giving you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as He has spoken, that you may greatly multiply, and that it may be well with you. This is the law and the judgment which Moses set before the children of Israel after they came out of the land of Egypt."
"Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one."
"You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your strength."
"And you shall bind these words of mine on your heart, and you shall teach them diligently to your children."
"And you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up."
"You shall bind them as a sign on your hand, and they shall be as frontlets between your eyes."
"And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house and on your gates."

sections.title: A warning given concerning the unrestrained.

verses.text: "The Lord your God will give you the land into which you enter, as He promised to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, a land of great and good cities which you did not build,
and houses full of all good things which you did not fill, and wells which you did not dig, and vineyards and olive trees which you did not plant; when you have eaten and are full,
Beware that you do not forget the Lord your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
You shall fear the Lord your God; Him you shall serve, and by His name you shall swear.
You shall not go after other gods, the gods of the peoples who are around you.
For the Lord your God is a jealous God among you, lest the anger of the Lord your God be aroused against you and destroy you from the face of the earth.
"You shall not tempt the Lord your God, as you tempted Him in Massah.
You shall diligently keep the commandments of the Lord your God, His testimonies, and His statutes which He has commanded you.
And it shall be well with you, and you shall go in and possess the good land which the Lord swore to your fathers, to give you,
that the Lord may take away all the enemies from before you, as He has spoken."
"But your son: Our God, the Lord, has commanded you a witness and a law; what is judgment? When you are asked this,
You say to your son: We were servants of Pharaoh in Egypt; but the Lord brought us out with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm He delivered us.
And the Lord set great and terrible signs before us in Egypt and upon Pharaoh and all his house.
To bring us to the land which He swore to our fathers, and to give us that land, He brought us forth from there.
As today, that we may live, and always be well, that we may fear our God, the Lord, and that we may do all this law which the Lord has commanded us.
And as He has commanded us, we shall do before our God, the Lord; if we keep all these commandments, it shall be mercy for us."

sections.title: Concerning the separation from the nations.

verses.text: "When the Lord thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
The Lord thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor show mercy unto them;
Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
"For thou art a holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
The Lord did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:

But because the Lord loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the Lord brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
Know therefore that the Lord thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face."
Therefore, I command you today to observe the statutes and the judgments, to keep the judgment.

sections.title: To obey the Lord is a blessing that shall be bestowed.

verses.text: "Thus shall it be; if you heed this judgment and keep it, and if you perform it, your God, the Lord, shall keep for you the covenant and mercy which He swore to your fathers."

"He shall love you; He shall bless you; He shall multiply you; He shall give you the fruit of your womb, the fruit of your land, your grain, your wine, your oil, the increase of your cattle, and the offspring of your sheep shall be blessed."
"You shall be more blessed than all peoples; there shall not be a male or female barren among you, nor among your livestock."

"When He comes upon the Egyptians, He shall remove from you all sickness and all the evil diseases that were seen upon you; and He shall not bring them upon you, but He shall send them upon all who hate you."
"Your God, the Lord, shall remove from you all the diseases of the nations; your eyes shall not see them; for they shall be for you a curse, and you shall not remember their idols."
"In your heart, you shall say: 'These nations are greater than I; how can I dispossess them?' You shall not be afraid of them."
"But you shall remember what the Lord your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt."

"Your God, the Lord, shall see your eyes, and He shall perform great wonders, signs, and miracles, and the mighty hand that brought you out; thus shall your God, the Lord, do to all the nations before whom you are afraid."
"Moreover, your God, the Lord, shall send forth His fear upon those who remain, and those who are hidden before you shall perish until they are destroyed."
"Do not be terrified before them; for your God, the Lord, is with you; He is your God, the Lord, who is great and mighty."

Your God, the Lord, shall cause these nations to perish before you, little by little; lest the land become desolate and the beasts of the field multiply against you, I shall swiftly cause them to perish; do not be afraid.
Your God, the Lord, shall deliver them into your hand, and until they are destroyed, He shall cause them to be greatly humbled before you.
Their kings shall He deliver into your hand; and their name shall He cause to perish from that place; until they are destroyed, no one shall be able to stand before you.

You shall burn their images in fire; and you shall not covet the silver and gold that is on them, nor take it for yourself; for it is an abomination to your God, the Lord, and you shall not bring any of it upon you.
You shall not bring a detestable thing into your house, lest you become accursed like it; you shall utterly detest it and you shall utterly abhor it, for it is accursed.

sections.title: A commandment given for the possession of the land of promise.

verses.text: "That you may live and multiply, and that the Lord your God may bring you into the land which He swore to your fathers, to give it to you, today you shall keep all the commandments that I command you."
"May your God, the Lord, guide you, and may you keep the commandments that are in your heart, whether you keep them or not, know that He will consider all the paths you take in the wilderness."

"For man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of the Lord; thus, do not be troubled, for you shall be reminded of what you do not know, as your fathers did not know."
"I have not put off my garments; my feet have not been washed; behold, it has been forty years."
"Just as a man cares for his son, so your God, the Lord, desires to care for you; be aware of this in your heart."
"As you walk in your way, fear Him, and keep the commandments of your God, the Lord."
"Your God, the Lord, shall lead you to a good and spacious land, where there are streams of water and fountains that spring forth from the plains and mountains."
"Wheat, barley, wine, and oil, and all that is good, shall be abundant in that land."
"Without hindrance, you shall eat the bread of the land; and there shall be nothing that you lack, for the stones shall be iron, and the mountains shall be rich with resources."
"You shall eat and be satisfied; you shall drink and be filled; for the good land that He has given you, you shall give thanks to your God, the Lord."

sections.title: A warning given that one should not forsake the Lord God.

verses.text: "Today, I command you to take heed of the commandments and the judgments, and to keep the statutes, lest you forget your God, the Lord."
"After you have eaten and are satisfied, build a good house and settle therein."
"When your herds and flocks have multiplied, and your silver and gold have increased, and all that you have is multiplied, take care lest your heart be lifted up."
"He who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage."
"The serpent that bites and the scorpion, and the darkness that is without water, in the great and terrible wilderness, He who brought forth water from the flinty rock."
"In the end, may He do good for you, that He may test you, that your fathers may not have known, and that you may not forget your God, the Lord, who led you in the wilderness."
"In your heart: 'By my strength, by my hand, I have done all this,' do not say."
"But today, as it is, remember the covenant that He made with your fathers, for He gives you strength; consider your God, the Lord."

"If you utterly forget your God, the Lord, and follow other gods, and serve them, and bow down to them, I declare to you today that I will testify against you, that I will call heaven and earth to witness against you."
"Because you have not listened to the word of your God, the Lord, He will destroy you from before Him, as He has done to all nations; so shall you also perish."

sections.title: The offering that is made unto the Lord shall be a sweet savor.

verses.text: "O Israel, hear; you shall enter the land which the Lord your God gives you, and you shall dispossess the nations greater and mightier than yourselves, cities great and fortified up to heaven, even to the Jordan today."
"And you know, concerning them: who can stand before the children of Enoch? When it is said, the great and numerous people are the children of Enoch."

"Your God, the Lord, shall pass before you today; He is a consuming fire; He shall destroy them; He shall subdue them before you; and the Lord shall drive them out from before you, as He has spoken to you, and He shall hasten to destroy them."

"When the Lord your God shall cast out those nations from before you, do not say in your heart, 'Because of my righteousness the Lord has brought me in to possess this good land,' for it is because of the wickedness of these nations that the Lord is driving them out before you."

"You shall not inherit their land because of your righteousness and the uprightness of your heart; but the Lord your God is driving them out from before you because of their wickedness, and to fulfill the word which He swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob."
"Therefore, you are a stiff-necked people, and your God, the Lord, has given you this good land as an inheritance; do not let it be said that it is because of your righteousness today."
"Consider how much you have provoked the Lord your God in the wilderness, from the day you departed from the land of Egypt until you came to this place; you have been rebellious against the Lord."
"At Horeb, you also provoked the Lord; and the Lord was angry with you to destroy you."

"The two stone tablets, which the Lord gave you, I received from Him; and when I went up to the mountain to receive the tablets, I remained on the mountain forty days and forty nights; I neither ate bread nor drank water."

"And the Lord gave me the two tablets of stone, written with the finger of God; and all the words which the Lord spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of the fire on the day of the assembly were written on the tablets."
And after forty days and forty nights, the Lord gave me the two tablets of stone, the tablets of the covenant.

And the Lord said unto me: "Arise, go down quickly from here; for your people, whom you brought out of Egypt, have corrupted themselves; they have quickly turned aside from the way which I commanded them; they have made themselves a molten image."
And the Lord said unto me: "Once, twice, I have spoken to you; this people has become stubborn and will not listen."
To destroy them, I will cause their name to be blotted out from under heaven; and I will make of you a nation mightier and greater than they."
And I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain burned with fire; and the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

Behold, before your God, the Lord, as you have sinned, you have made a molten image to keep you, that the Lord may not destroy you, and when I saw that you had quickly turned aside from the way which the Lord commanded you,
take hold of the two tablets; and I took them from my two hands and cast them before you.
For all the sins you have committed, to provoke Him to anger before the Lord, I fasted for forty days and forty nights; I ate no bread, and drank no water.
And the Lord was angry with you to destroy you, and I feared the anger and the wrath of the Lord; and the Lord also heard me at that time.
And the Lord was very angry with Aaron to destroy him; and I prayed for Aaron at that time also.

Because of the sin you have committed, I have taken the image of the avenger; I have burned it with fire; I have destroyed it; until it becomes like a heap, I have crushed it; and like a heap, I have cast it into the river that descends from the mountain.
"In the wilderness, in the trial, in the grave of desire, you have provoked the Lord your God."

And the Lord said: "Go forth; let the land which I have given you be destroyed; when I sent you from the gate of holiness, in the time of your God, by the word of your God, you have not believed; you have not heard my word."
From the day you were known, you were in the presence of the Lord as a people of His covenant.
"And the Lord said: 'Because you have been spoken of, as I had commanded you, for forty days and forty nights, I have been before the Lord.'"

And before the Lord, I prayed thus: "O Lord God of the armies, by Your great power, do not destroy Your people and Your inheritance, which You have brought out of Egypt by Your mighty hand and Your outstretched arm."
Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, Your servants, and do not look upon this people’s stubbornness, their wickedness, and their sin.
Those who brought us out of the land, O Lord, are not able to enter the land which You have given them; they have cried out to You, and therefore do not let them perish in the wilderness."
They are Your people and Your inheritance, whom You have brought out of the land of Egypt by Your great power and by Your outstretched arm.

sections.title: Moses received the Ten Commandments anew.

verses.text: "At that time, the Lord said, 'As for you, carve for yourself two tablets of stone like the first ones, and come up to Me on the mountain; and you shall make for yourself an ark of wood.'
"I will write on these tablets all the words that were on the first tablets, which you broke; and you shall put them in the ark."
"So I made an ark of acacia wood, and I carved two tablets of stone like the first ones, and I went up the mountain; and the two tablets were in my hand."

"And the Lord spoke to you out of the midst of the fire; you heard the sound of words, but saw no form; there was only a voice. And He declared to you His covenant, which He commanded you to perform, the Ten Commandments; and He wrote them on two tablets of stone."
"Then I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark which I had made; and the Lord commanded me, and there they are, as the Lord commanded me."
"And the children of Israel journeyed from Beeroth Benejaakan to Moseroth; there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered as priest in his place."
"From there they journeyed to Gudgodah, and from Gudgodah to Jotbathah, a land of rivers of water."

"At that time the Lord commanded me to teach you statutes and judgments, that you might observe them in the land which you cross over to possess; and the Lord your God has chosen you to be a people for Himself, a special treasure above all the peoples on the face of the earth."
"Therefore, the Levites shall have no part nor inheritance with their brethren; the Lord is their inheritance, as He said to them."
"And I stayed on the mountain forty days and forty nights; the Lord heard me at that time also, and the Lord chose not to destroy you."
And the Lord said, "Arise, go forth before the people; and to their fathers I shall give them, and they shall dwell in the land of their inheritance; and they shall be delivered."

sections.title: For he who seeks the Lord God of Israel, it is indeed to fear Him.

verses.text: "O Israel, what does the Lord your God require of you, but to fear the Lord your God, to walk in all His ways, to love Him, and to serve the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul?"
"Today, it is for you to keep the commandments and statutes of the Lord your God, that it may be well with you."
"Behold, to the Lord belong the heavens, the heavens of heavens, and the earth, and all that is in it; it is the Lord your God."
"The Lord chose your fathers, and He chose their descendants after them, you, from all the peoples, as it is this day."
"Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no longer stubborn."
"Your God, the Lord, is the God of gods, and the Lord of lords, a great God, mighty and awesome, who is not partial and takes no bribe."
"He executes justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the sojourner, giving him food and clothing."
"You were once strangers in the land of Egypt; therefore you shall love the sojourner."
"You shall fear the Lord your God; you shall serve Him and hold fast to Him, and by His name you shall swear."
"Your eyes have seen the great works that the Lord has done; He is your guide, and He is your God."
Your fathers were seventy souls when they went down to Egypt; and now the Lord your God hath made you as the stars of heaven for multitude.

sections.title: The benefit that comes from being instructed.

verses.text: "Thou shalt love the Lord thy God, and keep His commandments, His statutes, His judgments, and His ordinances all the days of thy life."
"Today, let your children know the works of your God, the greatness of His hand, and the wonders He has performed, that they may see and understand, and not forget."
"In the midst of Egypt, concerning the wonders and great works that He performed upon Pharaoh and all his land."
"As you followed Him, even until this day, in the waters of the sea, the Lord has preserved you, as He did in Egypt, against their horses and chariots."
"Until you come to this place, all that He has done for you in the wilderness."
"In all Israel, the land was raised up, and they and their households, their tents, and all that belonged to them were destroyed by the son of Reuben, by the sons of Eliab, by Dathan, and by Abiram."
"The great works that the Lord has done for you, your eyes have not seen."

sections.title: The land of the hopeful is blessed.

verses.text: "As you dwell in life, and as you multiply, and as you inherit the land which you shall possess, the land of the Jordan, keep all the commandments that I am giving you today;
The Lord your God shall give them to you and to your children after you, and the land which He swore to your fathers, that your days may be prolonged upon the land.
You shall inherit the land which you shall enter to possess, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the garden of the Lord, and as the land of Egypt, it is not like that.
But you shall inherit the land which you shall enter to possess, a land of hills and valleys, a country where the rain of heaven comes down.
Your God, the Lord, is a land of hills; from the beginning of the year to the end of the year, the eyes of the Lord your God are always upon it.
"You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might; and these words which I command you today shall be in your heart.
He shall give you the rain of your land in its season, the early rain and the latter rain, that you may gather in your grain, your new wine, and your oil.
He shall give grass in your fields for your cattle, that you may eat and be full.
Take heed to yourselves, lest your heart be deceived, and you turn aside and serve other gods and worship them;

And the anger of the Lord be kindled against you, and He shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest you perish quickly from off the good land which the Lord giveth you."

"Therefore, you shall bind these words upon your hearts and upon your souls; and you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up."
"You shall teach them to your children; speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up."
"And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house and upon your gates."
"That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD swore unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth."
"You shall love the LORD your God, and walk in all His ways, and keep His commandments, and His statutes, and His judgments, which I command you this day for your good."
"The LORD shall cause all these nations to be driven out from before you, and you shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves."

"Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours; from the wilderness and this Lebanon even unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and unto the great sea toward the going down of the sun shall be your coast."
"There shall not any man be able to stand before you; for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that you shall tread upon, as He hath said unto you."
"Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse."
"A blessing, if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day."
If you do not heed the command of the Lord your God, and today you say, "Let us go our own way," and if you follow other gods whom you do not know, it is to your own destruction.

The Lord your God shall grant you an inheritance, and when you enter the land to which you go, you shall dwell upon the blessings of the hills and the mountains, and you shall find rest upon the heights of the land.
And they are by the Jordan, in the meadow, behind the way that leads to the rising of the sun, dwelling among the Canaanites, and they are before the great tree at Gilgal.
Your God, the Lord, shall give you a land that you may dwell in forever, and you shall possess it, and you shall inherit it; you shall dwell therein and be established.
And I too, today, before you, shall establish all the statutes and judgments that you shall keep. Therefore, take heed.

sections.title: A place that is fitting for the offering of prayer.

verses.text: "In the time that you dwell upon the earth, the Lord your God, the God of your fathers, shall cause you to inherit the land which He shall give you; this is the ordinance and judgment which you shall observe."
"And you shall utterly destroy the nations which you shall dispossess, and you shall leave no place for the trees that are under every high mountain and under every green tree."

"And you shall break down their altars; and you shall smash their sacred pillars; and you shall cut down their wooden images; and you shall burn their carved images with fire; and you shall utterly destroy the name of them from that place."
"You shall not do so unto the Lord your God."
"But the Lord your God shall choose one place out of all your tribes to put His name there; and there shall you go."

"And there you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the offerings of your hand, and your vowed offerings, and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and of your flocks."
"And there you shall eat before the Lord your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you put your hand unto, you and your households, in that the Lord your God hath blessed you."
"Every man shall see what is good in his own eyes; but we shall not do all that we do today."
"Your God, the Lord, has not yet brought you to the place of rest and the inheritance which He has given you until this day."

"But when you cross over the Jordan, the Lord your God shall bring you into the land which you are to possess; and you shall dwell there without fear, and He shall give you rest from all your enemies."

At that time, your God, the Lord, shall be called upon by His name, and to that place which He has chosen, you shall bring all your offerings, your sacrifices that are to be consumed, your burnt offerings, your tithes, and all the first fruits of your hand, and all that you have vowed to the Lord your God.
And you, your sons and your daughters, and your male and female servants, shall rejoice before the Lord your God, for there is no portion nor inheritance for you in your midst.
Take heed that you do not offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see.
However, you shall offer your burnt offerings to the Lord your God at the place which He shall choose among your tribes, and there you shall do all that I command you today.

"But your God, the Lord, as He has given you a blessing, as He has commanded you, shall cause you to eat flesh in all your cities; you shall eat it, as the clean person eats, and as the unclean person eats, so shall it be eaten."
But you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it out on the ground like water.

You shall not be able to eat the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your herd or of your flock, nor any of your vowed offerings, nor any freewill offerings, nor any offerings that you have vowed in your cities.

However, you, your son and your daughter, your male and female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates, shall rejoice before the Lord your God in the place which He shall choose; and in all that you set your hand to do, may you rejoice before the Lord your God.
Take heed that you do not forsake the Levite as long as you live in your land.
"Your God, the Lord, as He has spoken to you, when He enlarges your borders, and when your soul desires to eat flesh, you may eat flesh as your soul desires; you may eat it as you desire."

Your God, the Lord, shall be called by that name; even if the chosen place be far from you, the Lord shall command you to offer your lamb and your goat as He has given you; and your body shall consume that which has been desired in your land.
Just as the locusts and the grasshoppers eat, so shall they eat; let the clean man eat, and let the unclean also eat.
Take heed that you do not eat blood; for the blood is the life of the flesh, and the soul shall not eat with the flesh.
On the earth, do not eat as the waters flow.
When you do what is good and pleasing in the sight of your God, the Lord, for you, and for your children after you, may it be well with you; do not eat.
However, concerning that which is holy to you, take your offering, and let your God, the Lord, be called by that name; go to the chosen place.

Prepare a sacrifice that is to be offered, and bring it to your God, the Lord, at His altar; and let the blood of your sacrifice be poured out at your God, the Lord's altar, and let the flesh be eaten.

When you do what is good and pleasing in the sight of your God, the Lord, for you, and for your children after you, may it be well with you forever; therefore, I command you to keep all these words that I have spoken to you.

sections.title: It is fitting to give thanks to the idols.

verses.text: "Thou shalt not cause thy God, the Lord, to be inherited by the nations which thou shalt drive out from before thee; and when thou art settled in their land, thou shalt not seek to follow them after they are destroyed before thee."
"Neither shalt thou serve their gods; for they will be a snare unto thee. Take heed to thyself, lest thou be ensnared and say, 'I will serve their gods.'"

"Thou shalt not do so unto thy God, the Lord; for every nation doth abominably unto their gods, even burning their sons and their daughters in the fire; which thing the Lord thy God hath not commanded thee."
"I command thee this day to keep all these words; take heed to do them, and add nothing to them, nor diminish aught from them."
“ከአንተም ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ ቢነሣ፥ ምልክትም፥ ተአምራትም ቢሰጥህ፥
እርሱም፦ ሄደን የማታውቃቸውን ሌሎች አማልክት እንከተል እናምልካቸውም ብሎ የተናገረህ ምልክቱ ወይም ተአምራቱ ቢፈጸም፥
አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን በፍጹም ልባችሁ፥ በፍጹምም ነፍሳችሁ ትወድዱት እንደሆን ያውቅ ዘንድ አምላካችሁ እግዚአብሔር ሊፈትናችሁ ነውና የዚያን ነቢይ ቃል ወይም ያን ሕልም አላሚ አትስሙ።
አምላካችሁን እግዚአብሔርን ተከተሉ፤ እርሱንም ፍሩ፤ ትእዛዙንም ጠብቁ፤ ቃሉንም ስሙ፥ እርሱንም ተማጠኑት።
ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣችሁ፥ ከባርነትም ቤት ካዳናችሁ ከአምላካችሁ ከእግዚአብሔር ሊያስታችሁ፥ አምላክህ እግዚአብሔርም ትሄድባት ዘንድ ካዘዘህ መንገድ ሊያወጣህ ተናግሮአልና ያ ነቢይ ወይም ሕልም አላሚ ይገደል፤ እንዲሁም ክፉውን ነገር ከአንተ አርቅ።
“የአባትህ ወይም የእናትህ ልጅ ወንድምህ ወይም ወንድ ልጅህ ወይም ሴት ልጅህ ወይም አብራህ የምትተኛ ሚስትህ ወይም እንደ ነፍስህ ያለ ወዳጅህ በስውር፦ ና፥ ሄደን አንተም አባቶችህም የማታውቋቸውን ሌሎች አማልክት እናምልክ ብሎ ቢያስትህ፥
ከምድር ዳር ጀምሮ እስከ ምድር ዳር ድረስ ወደ አንተ የቀረቡት ከአንተም የራቁት አንተን ከብበውህ ያሉ አሕዛብ ከሚያመልኩአቸው አማልክት፥
ከእርሱ ጋር አትተባበር፤ አትስማውም፤ ዐይንህም አይራራለት፤ አትማረውም፤ አትሸሽገውም፤
ነገር ግን ፈጽመህ ተናገር፤ እርሱን ለመግደል በፊት ያንተ እጅ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ የሕዝቡ ሁሉ እጅ በላዩ ትሁን።
ከግብፅ ምድር ከባርነት ቤት ካወጣህ ከአምላክህ ከእግዚአብሔር ሊያርቅህ ወድዶአልና በድንጋይ ይውገሩት፤ ይግደሉትም።
Let all Israel hear and fear; let not such wickedness arise again in your midst.
"The Lord your God has given you cities to dwell in among the cities of your inheritance;
Let the wicked ones depart from among you; if they go and proclaim to the people of their city, saying, 'Come, let us serve other gods,' and you hear the report,
You shall seek and inquire; you shall ask, and behold, if it be true, that this wicked thing has been done in your midst,
Your land shall be struck down by the sword, and you shall utterly smite its inhabitants; all that is within it shall be destroyed.
And all its goods shall be gathered to its place; and the city shall be burned with fire before the Lord your God, and it shall remain a desolation forever; it shall not be built again.

The anger of the Lord your God shall turn away, and He shall not destroy you, as He has spoken to your fathers; He shall not forsake you, nor shall He abandon you; do not let anything that is abominable remain in your hand.
Today, if you keep all the commandments that I command you, and do what is good and right in the sight of the Lord your God, you shall be a son to Him."

sections.title: The way of the righteous is like the dawn, shining ever brighter until the full light of day.

verses.text: "Do not lift up your face before the dead, nor shall you seek your own life."
"For you are a holy people unto your God, the Lord; and the Lord hath chosen you to be a peculiar people unto Himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth."

sections.title: The creatures that eat and those that do not eat.

verses.text: “ርኩስን ነገር ሁሉ አትብሉ።
የምትበሉአቸው እንስሶች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ በሬ፥ በግ፥ ፍየል፥
ዋልያ፥ ሚዳቋ፥ የበረሃ ፍየል፥ ጎሽ፥ ብሖር፥ ሳላ፥ ድኵላ።
ከእንስሶች ሰኰናው የተሰነጠቀውን፥ ጥፍሩም ከሁለት የተከፈለውን፥ የሚያመሰኳውንም እንስሳ ሁሉ ትበላለህ።
ነገር ግን ከሚያመሰኩ ወይም ሰኰናቸው ከተሰነጠቀ እነዚህን አትበሉም፤ ግመልን፥ ሽኮኮን፥ ጥንቸልን አትበሉም፤ ያመሰኳሉና፥ ነገር ግን ሰኰናቸው አልተሰነጠቀምና እነዚህ ለእናንተ ርኩሳን ናቸው።
እርያም፥ ሰኰናው ስለተሰነጠቀ፥ ጥፍሩም ከሁለት ስለተከፈለ፥ ነገር ግን ሰለማያመሰኳ፥ እርሱ ለእናንተ ርኩስ ነው፤ ሥጋዉን አትብሉ፤ በድኑንም አትንኩ።
“በውኆች ውስጥ ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ የምትበሉአቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ክንፍና ቅርፊትም ያላቸውን ትበላላችሁ፤
ክንፍና ቅርፊትም የሌላቸውን አትበሉም፤ ለእናንተ ርኩሳን ናቸው።
“ንጹሓን የሆኑትን ወፎች ሁሉ ብሉ።
ሊበሉ የማይገባቸው ግን እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ንስር፥ ገዴ፥ ዓሣ አውጭ።
ጭልፊት፥ ጭላትና መሰሎቻቸው፥
ቍራና መሰሎቹ፤
ሰጎን፥ አራት ራስ አሞራ፥ ዝዪ፥ በቋል በየወገኑ።
ጉጉት፥ ጋጋኖ፥ የውኃ ዶሮ።
ይብራ፥ ጥምብ አንሣ አሞራና መሰሎቻቸው፥
ዕርኩም፥ ሽመላ፥ ሳቢሳና መሰሎቹ፥ ጅንጅላቴ ወፍ፥ የሌሊት ወፍ።
የሚበርሩም አዕዋፍ ሁሉ ለእናንተ ንጹሓን አይደሉምና ከእነርሱ አትብሉ፤
ነገር ግን ንጹሓን የሆኑትን ወፎች ሁሉ ብሉ።
የበከተዉን ሁሉ አትብሉ፤ ይበላው ዘንድ በሀገርህ ደጅ ለተቀመጠ መጻተኛ ወይም ለባዕድ ስጠው፤ አንተ ለአምላካህ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ሕዝብ ነህና፥ የፍየሉን ጠቦት በእናቱ ወተት አትቀቅል።

sections.title: The Law of the Ten Commandments

verses.text: "From your harvest, you shall bring forth all the tithe of your grain, as you receive it each year."

"In all your seasons, you shall learn to fear your God, the Lord, that His name may be called upon you; and in the chosen place before your God, you shall eat your tithe of your grain, of your wine, of your oil, and of the firstborn of your herd and your flock."

"The Lord your God shall bless you, and though your way may be far, the Lord your God shall cause His name to dwell among you; if the chosen place be far from you, and you are unable to carry it there,"
"You shall sell it for money, and with the money in your hand, you shall go to the chosen place."

"And there you shall buy whatever your soul desires, whether oxen or sheep, or wine or strong drink, whatever your soul longs for; and you shall eat there before the Lord your God, and you and your household shall rejoice."
"And since there is no inheritance or portion for you, do not neglect the Levite who is within your city."
"At the end of every third year, you shall bring all the tithes of your produce in that year, and you shall store it within your cities."

"And the Levite, because he has no portion or inheritance with you, and the sojourner, and the fatherless, and the widow who are within your city shall come and eat and be satisfied; that the Lord your God may bless you in all the work of your hand that you do."

sections.title: The year of the debt that shall be released.

verses.text: "In every seventh year, thou shalt grant a release of debts."

"And this is the commandment concerning the release; thou shalt not require payment from thy neighbor or thy brother for any debt that is owed to thee; for the mercy of thy God, the Lord, is proclaimed."
"But from the foreigner, thou mayest accept all that is thine; however, from thy brother, let it go."
"The Lord thy God shall bless thee in the land which He giveth thee for an inheritance, and He shall surely bless thee, so that there shall be no poor among thee."
"If thou shalt hearken to the word of the Lord thy God, and shalt do according to all that I command thee this day, and shalt keep all these commandments."
"The Lord thy God shall bless thee as He hath spoken; and thou shalt lend to many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee."
"If there be among you a poor man of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the Lord thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thy heart, nor shut thy hand from thy poor brother."
"But thou shalt open thy hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth."

"The seventh year shall be the year of release; and if thou sayest, 'The seventh year is at hand,' let not evil thoughts arise in thy heart against thy poor brother; for he may cry unto the Lord against thee, and it shall be sin unto thee."

"In all that thou doest, the Lord thy God shall bless thee; therefore, complete thy work, and do not withhold from him that is in need; and in the time that is given to thee, let not thy heart be grieved."
The poor shall not cease from the land; therefore I command you, saying, "You shall open your hand wide to your brother, to your poor, and to your needy in your land."

sections.title: The year in which the captives shall go free.

verses.text: "You shall also serve your Hebrew brother or your Hebrew sister for six years; but in the seventh year, you shall let them go free from you."
"And when you let them go free from you, you shall not let them go empty-handed."
"However, from your flock, from your threshing floor, and from your winepress, you shall give to them as the Lord your God has blessed you."
"Remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the Lord your God redeemed you; therefore, I command you this thing today."
"And if it happens that he says to you, 'I will not go away from you,' because he loves you and your house, since he is well off with you—"
"Then you shall take an awl and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever. Also, to your female servant you shall do likewise."

"And if it happens that he says to you, 'I will not go away from you,' because he loves you and your house, since he is well off with you—do not be distressed, for the Lord your God will bless you in all that you do."

sections.title: The dominion of the beasts.

verses.text: "You shall sanctify to your God the firstborn of your herd and the firstborn of your flock; you shall not work with your bull when it is in its first year, nor shall you shear your sheep in their first year."
"Your God, the Lord, shall choose a place for you and your household to appear before Him each year."
"If there be a blemished animal, whether it be blind, or lame, or have any evil blemish, you shall not offer it to your God, the Lord."
"In your land, you shall eat; the clean person, and the unclean person, shall eat as the deer and the gazelle are eaten."
"However, you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it upon the ground like water."

sections.title: In the world of Passover

verses.text: "In the month of Abib, you shall go forth from the land of Egypt by night, and you shall keep the month of Abib; you shall observe the Passover of the Lord your God."
"The Lord your God shall be called by that name; therefore, in the chosen place, you shall offer the Passover to the Lord your God from the flock and from the herd."

"You shall not eat the bread of affliction with it; for you came forth from the land of Egypt in haste, that you may remember the day when you came forth from the land of Egypt all the days of your life; and you shall eat unleavened bread for seven days with it."
"For seven days, no leaven shall be seen in your land; and on the first day, from evening until morning, no leaven shall be found in your possession."
"The Lord your God shall not allow you to offer the Passover in any of your cities which He gives you."
"But the Lord your God shall be called by that name; therefore, in the chosen place, in the month when you came forth from Egypt, at sunset, you shall observe the Passover."
"The Lord your God shall keep you in the chosen place; you shall be blessed; you shall eat there; and in the evening, you shall return to your house."

"For six days, you shall eat unleavened bread; but on the seventh day, since it is the day of departure, let it be a feast to the Lord your God; and you shall not do any work, except that which your soul desires."

sections.title: The Feast of Testing;

verses.text: "You shall count seven weeks; from the day you begin to put the sickle to the standing grain, you shall begin to count seven weeks."
"The Lord your God shall bless you in all the work of your hands, and you shall celebrate the Feast of Weeks before the Lord your God, as you are able."

"You, your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite who is within your gates, and the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow who are among you, shall rejoice before the Lord your God in the place He chooses to make His name dwell."
"Remember that you were a slave in Egypt; therefore you shall observe this commandment."

sections.title: The Feast of the Dedication

verses.text: "When you gather the harvest of your threshing floor and your winepress, celebrate a feast for the Lord your God for seven days."
"You, your son and your daughter, your male servant and your female servant, and the Levite, the stranger, the orphan, and the widow who are within your gates, shall rejoice in your feast."

"The Lord your God shall choose a place for His name to dwell, and there you shall celebrate the feast of the Lord your God for seven days; and the Lord your God shall bless you in all the produce of your harvest and in all the work of your hands, and you shall surely rejoice."

"Three times a year all your males shall appear before the Lord your God in the place which He chooses: at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Tabernacles; and they shall not appear before the Lord empty-handed."
"You shall not appear before the Lord empty-handed. Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you."

sections.title: Concerning Judgment and Justice

verses.text: "Thou shalt not be partial in judgment; thou shalt hear the small as well as the great; thou shalt not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God's: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it."
"Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, nor take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous."
"Thou shalt live, and the Lord thy God shall give thee the land which thou art to possess; therefore, follow after true judgment."

sections.title: The safeguarding of the altar of sacrifice.

verses.text: "Do not be dismayed by any tree that you may encounter near the altar of your God, the Lord; for it is a place of worship and should not be desecrated."
"Your God, the Lord, shall not forsake you for any falsehood that may be spoken against you."
"Thou shalt not offer unto thy God, the Lord, any beast that is torn or injured, whether it be a bull or a sheep."
"If a man or a woman be found among you in one of thy cities, which the Lord thy God giveth thee, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the Lord thy God, in transgressing his covenant,"
"If thou shalt see others worshipping any other gods, whether it be to the sun or to the moon, or to any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded,"
"If it be told thee, and thou hast heard, then thou shalt inquire diligently; and behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you,"
"Then thou shalt bring forth that man or that woman which have committed that wicked thing unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and thou shalt stone them with stones till they die."
"At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death."
"The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put away the evil from among you."

sections.title: The judgments that are given by the priests and the judges.

verses.text: "Between blood and blood, between judgment and judgment, between slaying and slaying, between strife and strife, if there be a matter of judgment that arises among the people within thy land, thou shalt arise and go to the place which the Lord thy God shall choose; there thou shalt call upon His name."
"And unto the Levite priests shalt thou go in those days, and thou shalt inquire of them; and they shall declare unto thee the matter of judgment."
"Thou shalt call upon the name of the Lord thy God in that chosen place, and as they have spoken unto thee, so shalt thou do; and thou shalt keep the law which they shall teach thee."
"As they have taught thee the law, so shalt thou execute judgment; thou shalt not turn aside from the judgment which they shall declare unto thee, to the right hand nor to the left."

"If any man shall rise up against thee, to serve the name of the Lord thy God, and hearken not to the priest that standeth there, or to the judge that is in those days, that man shall die; and thou shalt put away the evil from Israel."
"And all the people shall hear and fear; and henceforth they shall not do any more presumptuously."

sections.title: Concerning the commandments given regarding the king.

verses.text: "The Lord thy God shall give thee a land as an inheritance, when thou enterest into it, and at the time of thy inheritance, and when thou art settled therein: if thou sayest, 'I shall set a king over me like all the nations that are round about me,'
Among thy brethren, the Lord thy God shall choose for thee a king; thou mayest not set a stranger over thee, which is not thy brother.

That he may not multiply horses to himself, nor cause the people to return to Egypt, to the end that he should multiply horses; forasmuch as the Lord hath said unto you, 'Ye shall henceforth return no more that way.'
Neither shall he multiply wives to himself, that his heart turn not away; neither shall he greatly multiply to himself silver and gold.
"And it shall be, when he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book out of that which is before the priests the Levites.
And it shall be with him, and he shall read therein all the days of his life; that he may learn to fear the Lord his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them.

That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left; to the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom, he and his children in the midst of Israel."

sections.title: The portion of the priests and the Levites.

verses.text: "To the Levite priests, to all the descendants of Levi, there shall be no portion or inheritance with Israel; the offerings made by fire to the Lord are their inheritance; and they shall be regarded as His."
"Among their brethren, there shall be no inheritance; for the Lord is their inheritance, as He has spoken to them."
"For the cattle or the sheep that may be offered by the people, this shall be the priests' due: the shoulder, the two cheeks, and the maw shall be given to the priest."
"Of your grain, of your wine, and of your oil, the firstfruits, and of the firstborn of your flock, you shall give to him."
"He shall stand before your God, before the Lord, and minister to Him, and he shall be blessed in His name; for the Lord your God has chosen him out of all your tribes."
"If a Levite comes from any of your cities in Israel, where he dwells, and comes with all the desire of his mind to the place which the Lord chooses,"
"He shall minister in the name of the Lord his God, as all his brethren the Levites do, who stand there before the Lord."
"He shall receive a share like the other Levites, in addition to the value of the cattle from his fathers."

sections.title: Concerning the keeping of the commandments of the Lord.

verses.text: "Thou shalt not commit the abominations which those nations do, when the Lord thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it."
"If a man or a woman shall be found among you that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the Lord thy God, whether by fire, or by any other means, they shall be put to death."

"And if they be found guilty of such things, they shall be called to account; they shall be put to death, and their blood shall be upon them, for they have committed iniquity in the sight of the Lord."
"All who do such things are an abomination unto the Lord; therefore, the Lord thy God shall cut them off from before thee."
"But thou shalt be perfect with the Lord thy God."
"These nations, which thou shalt dispossess, shall be guilty of such wickedness; but for thee, it shall not be so; for the Lord thy God hath not permitted it."

sections.title: A prophet shall arise like unto Moses.

verses.text: "The Lord your God will raise up for you a prophet like me from among your brethren; him you shall hear."
"Your God, the Lord, on the day when you were gathered at Horeb, said: 'Let us not hear the voice of the Lord our God, nor see this great fire anymore, lest we die.'"
"And the Lord said to me: 'What they have spoken is good.'"
"I will raise up for them a prophet like you from among their brethren; and I will put my words in his mouth, and he shall speak to them all that I command him."
"And it shall be that whoever will not hear my words which he speaks in my name, I will require it of him."
"But the prophet who presumes to speak a word in my name, which I have not commanded him to speak, or who speaks in the name of other gods, that prophet shall die."
"And if you say in your heart, 'How shall we know the word which the Lord has not spoken?'"

"When a prophet speaks in the name of the Lord, if the thing does not happen or come to pass, that is the thing which the Lord has not spoken; the prophet has spoken it presumptuously; you shall not be afraid of him."

sections.title: The cities of refuge.

verses.text: "The Lord your God, when He gives you the land which He is about to destroy the nations before you, and when you dwell in their cities and in their houses,"
"The Lord your God shall designate for you three cities in the midst of your land which He gives you."
"And for you, He shall prepare your way; and the Lord your God shall cause you to inherit the land, and you shall divide it into three parts; it shall be a refuge for every slayer."
"This is the law concerning the slayer: if he strikes his neighbor without having been previously at enmity with him, and he did not know it, and he flees there, he shall live."

"If a man goes into the woods with his neighbor to cut wood, and his hand swings the axe to cut down the tree, and the iron slips from the handle and strikes his neighbor, and he dies, he shall flee to one of these cities and live;"
"But if he is a man of blood, he shall not be able to find refuge, for his way is far, lest he be caught and killed; for the enemy had not been before him, and death shall not come upon him."
"Therefore, I say unto you: I will set apart three cities for you."
"And the Lord your God, as He has spoken concerning your fathers, shall enlarge your borders; and if He gives you all the land which He has spoken unto your fathers,"
"You shall love the Lord your God, and you shall walk in all His ways; and today, if you shall hearken to this commandment, you shall add three more cities to these three cities."
"The Lord your God shall grant you that within the land which He gives you, no innocent blood shall be shed, and within you, there shall be no bloodthirsty man."
"Yet if a man should rise against his neighbor, and should smite him, and should lift himself against him, and should slay him, if he should perish in one of these cities,"
"The elders of the city shall send and fetch him; and they shall deliver him into the hand of the avenger of blood, and he shall die."
"Your eye shall not pity him; but you shall surely put away the innocent blood from Israel, and it shall be well with you."

sections.title: A boundary that cannot be transgressed.

verses.text: "Thou shalt not remove thy neighbor's landmark, which they of old time have set in thine inheritance, which thou shalt inherit in the land that the Lord thy God giveth thee to possess."

sections.title: A directive concerning witnesses.

verses.text: "Concerning every sin, and for every evil deed that is done, let there not be a single witness against any man; but by the mouth of two witnesses or three witnesses shall every word be established."
"If a false witness rises against a man to testify against him in wrongdoing,"
"Both the accusers shall stand before the Lord, before the priests and the judges who shall be in those days."
"And the judges shall make diligent inquiry; and if the witness is a false witness, having testified falsely against his brother,"
"Then you shall do to him as he had intended to do to his brother; and you shall put away the evil from among you."
"And the others shall hear and fear; and henceforth they shall not do such evil among you."
"Your eye shall not pity; life for life, eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot shall be rendered."

sections.title: Concerning the commandments given regarding warfare.
